text: 下周Q2财报来袭，腾讯控股(00700.HK)、京东(09618.HK)、中国移动(00941.HK)、中芯国际(00981.HK)等重要个股将于下周公布财报。经济数据方面，中国7月M2货币供应年率；美国7月CPI、PPI等数据将于下周公布。此外，下周多位美联储官员发表讲话，敬请留意。完整个股财报日历请前往美港电讯APP—日历查看。点击查看...
text_en: Next week's Q2 earnings season kicks off, with key stocks including Tencent Holdings (00700.HK), JD.com (09618.HK), China Mobile (00941.HK), and SMIC (00981.HK) set to report results. On the economic data front, China's July M2 money supply year-on-year figure, as well as US July CPI and PPI, will be released next week. Additionally, multiple Fed officials are scheduled to speak next week. For the full earnings calendar, please visit the MHTK app—Calendar. Click to view...
